description: This file defines a ref-struct 'ExecutionContextSuppressor' that manages the suppression and restoration of the ExecutionContext flow in .NET, ensuring that context flow is suppressed during its lifetime and restored upon disposal.

classes.name: ExecutionContextSuppressor
classes.description: A ref-struct that suppresses the flow of ExecutionContext until disposed, to control context flow in asynchronous operations.

methods.name: ExecutionContextSuppressor
methods.description: Constructor that suppresses the ExecutionContext flow if it is not already suppressed.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Restores the ExecutionContext flow if it was suppressed by this instance.
